steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: George, everyone willing to go is here.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: What about Tommy?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: No sign of him.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: That's fine. Volunteers only.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: George.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: You found what Catherine left for you, Feist? Was it what you were looking for?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: I'm glad.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Now get going, before you can't.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Wait, what's going on?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Do you know why the Sarkaz took Catherine?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: She knew too much. They're executing workers like her.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Something didn't feel right, so I had Day climb to the top of the factory to check.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Catherine kept it from us. She thought we didn't know anything.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: But we aren't stupid. We guessed what's going on.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What are you gonna do?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Nothing in particular.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: We've put up with the Sarkaz for a long time.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: More or less gotten used to it.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Some folk think the Sarkaz will let us go, so long as we put up with them a little longer.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Now they want to do away with Catherine.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You'll die.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Better than standing around and watching them kill Catherine.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: No one standing here has anything left to lose.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: You're with the Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: We've heard about you. Lots of us are happy for you.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: You've got more important things to do.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Don't let Catherine's sacrifice be in vain.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, I may have gotten some information from Granny...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But as the leader of this factory, Granny knows more about the Sarkaz production lines than anyone else.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: She has significant strategic value, doesn't she?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...I request help from Rhodes Island.

options: I know you're watching... here with me.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Here.

options: I'm sure you've identified the hostiles in this sector.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: They've tightened defenses, leaving gaps on the outside.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: It's mostly loosely-organized mercenary bands guarding the outer area.

options: Distract the mercenaries and take out the sentries.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: On it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor, Ascalon.
Feist takes a deep breath.
He sticks his badge to his chest and goes in amongst the workers.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Don't make any rash decisions, Feist.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm not here as a member of the Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm here as the grandson of Catherine, as someone who grew up in this factory.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I belong here.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Just like you, I don't want Catherine to die.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm not gonna let her die, and I won't let you die either.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The Doctor's people will cut off Sarkaz communications.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Once we rescue Granny and the other factory bosses, we'll have plenty of time to get out of Highbury.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'll lead you to the Corps.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Everyone will be safe.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...Everyone should be safe.
The workers exchange stunned looks.
But they see the fire of hope beginning to burn in each others' eyes.
One by one, they get behind Feist.
They have decided to trust Feist.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Feist! I-I'm going too!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Tommy... thanks.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But don't.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You hesitated because your dad's not well, right?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: And there's something I need you to do.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No matter the outcome, you will report to the Sarkaz that we staged a riot.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's important. I have to keep the ones who stay behind safe.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let's go, then.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We'll get the old hands back.

steps.name: Londinium Workers
steps.text: Right!
Catherine smokes her cigarette quietly.
She watches as the Sarkaz drag one familiar face after another to the makeshift firing range.
She sees on those familiar faces anger, disgust, resignation.
Then, in the end, peace.
She knows her turn will come soon.
She feels a sense of calm that she has never felt before.
Feist was right.
Compromise and subservience will solve no problems.
She must pay for her choices.
But she got to see her grandson one last time, and left him a little gift, before she had to pay.
That's enough.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: You're up, grandma.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Take her.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I can walk on my own.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Oh. Paprika.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Grimm never had you kill anybody, did he?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: ...Never.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Here's your chance.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Learn to kill.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: This is how the Sarkaz treat a kid?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: I heard what you said to her. You're right. She doesn't know what war is.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: I didn't want to know what war was, if I could help it. No Sarkaz does.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: But you left us no choice. None of you did. That's why it's time for her to learn.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: I like that look in your eyes, grandma.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: It's the same look I've seen on buddies who died with their eyes wide open.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I've killed a lot.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: But it doesn't sit right with me, killing someone who can't fight back.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: You can go back where you came from, if you don't have the stomach for it.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: How do you know these workers didn't build the weapons that were used to kill your own people?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Morals are for peacetime. This is war. It's an argument we never got to have on fair, equal ground.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: I don't need you to tell me that. I just...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Huh? A drone?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: This is the place! I've scanned the area with the drone!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Move!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: C-Can't I let someone else do it?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: I'm sure Grimm taught you not to question your captain's orders.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Either you kill her, or drop your weapon and I kill you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Do it.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Do it!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I... I can't!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: ...I always said Grimm was too soft on you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: We're not here to convince the Victorians to give our homeland back. If you can't do it, you're going to get it—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Huh—a drone?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary
steps.text: Captain! The workers are revolting!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Feist, we've got the Doctor giving orders here. We'll keep the mercenaries pinned down. Go and get Catherine!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Are you out of your minds?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No, we're not.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Do you know how valuable an experienced worker is?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They're in high demand, you know.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Feist! You—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: You could have lived longer if you pretended not to know anything.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Too bad Granny always says I never know when to shut up.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: You think you can beat me?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No, but maybe she can.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Wha—

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Umph...!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Bollocks, that thing was heavy...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Thanks, George. That felt good.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Thank Feist.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: What about you, Sarkaz? Not gonna fight?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: ...Girl.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Your captain was right. This isn't the time to talk about right or wrong. We can't.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But if you don't know what you're fighting for...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Y-You can't go...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Guess I've got no choice then.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Charge!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What's going on? Where is everybody?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I'm gonna have to report this, if I don't get a response—

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Argh...
The Sarkaz warrior feels weightless.
In his blurring vision, he sees a black figure just before he collapses.
It was another Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Why... Sarkaz...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Last one.
Ascalon is talking to herself, but she puts away the weapon with complete confidence that she is right.
She can clearly see the angry workers routing the Sarkaz mercenaries from her position.
Violence without strength of numbers was easily broken before years of pent-up anger.
The balance of power is reversed. Memories float to the surface.
She casts her gaze in another direction.
The center of Londinium.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We've tied up all the mercs.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: How many injuries?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Not many. The mercenaries with this kid were in a panic and slow to react.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: They didn't even make up their mind to fight.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: W-We—!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: We... we just...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You tried to resist, but you were ambushed by cunning Londiniers.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Their way, only a few old timers had to die.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Now the Sarkaz will have all your heads.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Is this your clever idea, Feist? Put all these years of patience to waste?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: If we watched you sacrifice yourselves to save our skins today, there'd be another group of victims tomorrow.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Until everyone only cares about themselves.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: And... that's not your choice to make for all of us.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You're right. But it's not yours either.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: This time, though, everyone came to rescue you of their own accord.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The Sarkaz have occupied the city for years... life is hard, but there are some red lines we can't let them cross. If we didn't come here today, we—

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: The Sarkaz will eventually boil us all.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: George... you too.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: It's not all of you here. That means there are some who don't want to see me come back alive.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Reality is crueler than you think, Feist. Right and wrong isn't so simple.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But what's done is done...
Catherine looks at Feist. It seems like she wants to say something.
She does not, however.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Let's go.
